exposure: abdominal sonographic lower uterine segment (LUS) thickness
cohort: The study involved 111 full-term pregnant women who were scheduled for repeat cesarean delivery.
finding: Abdominal sonography is a valuable tool for the preoperative prediction of cesarean scar defect (CSD), with a myometrial LUS thickness of more than 1.5 mm associated with a lower likelihood of cesarean scar dehiscence.
cross-section timing: Measurements were taken prior to surgery for repeat cesarean delivery, with data collected from April 2019 to January 2020.
